name: thicken
description: Photos in; out comes a 3D model (GLB) at the object's real size and its metadata as JSON. A profile for each kind of object; add your own.

vision_url.title: Vision endpoint (optional)
vision_url.description: An OpenAI-compatible API, such as https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 or your own server. With one, photos needn't be cropped and the models read what's printed. Each photo is sent there.

vision_key.title: Vision endpoint's key (optional)
vision_key.description: Sent only to the vision endpoint, never recorded.

vision_models.title: Vision models (optional)
vision_models.description: Your endpoint's model names, comma-separated, primary first: the first two are asked together.

google_books_key.title: Google Books API key (optional)
google_books_key.description: Your own quota for book sizes; without one, Google Books is asked on the shared keyless quota. Sent only to Google Books.

contribute.title: Contribute photos to the corner model thicken uses?
contribute.description: yes sends the photos you make models from, as the 1000 x 1000 frames the vision models see, to train the corner model thicken uses: no account or name attached, released as CC0, reviewed by thicken's author before any use; not sent: file names, camera details, location. You must be 16 or older and the photos must be yours. no never sends them; ask leaves it to thicken's own question. Change it any time: thicken contribute off. Details: https://github.com/bikemeardsley/thicken/blob/main/PRIVACY.md#contributing-photos
